category_title: Improving ELL student motivated by practical and interest-based literacy
scenario_title: Independent reading with unfamiliar topics or hard words
minimal_context: Jesus is reading his choice book, Monster, during sustained silent reading time in English class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for sustained silent reading. Please take out your choice book, Monster, and read quietly.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay. I picked this one because the story seemed realistic. I used to read pretty slow and not understand the words but now I’m a lot better.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is good to hear. Please begin reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm trying, but the words are hard to understand in this part.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying your best to read it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts the book down and turns to watch the other students in the class) I can't focus when these words are so hard. It just makes reading unappealing, and I'd rather see what they are doing.

STUDENT: (Puts the book down and turns to watch the other students in the class) I can't focus when these words are so hard. It just makes reading unappealing, and I'd rather see what they are doing.
